scope.research_question: Can a separately trained FF5-plus-momentum negative-alpha specialist identify the worst future alpha tail better than reversing the frozen general FF5-alpha selector?

target.construction: Exact sign reversal: higher target values denote more negative next-holding-period FF5-plus-momentum residual alpha.

frozen_control.interpretation: The existing general FF5-alpha score reversed so that high values indicate predicted negative alpha.

search.ensembles: Reuse every prespecified V6.1 equal and causal dynamic ensemble; direct CAM is sign-reversed for the negative-alpha orientation.
search.operating_schedule: Reuse the frozen V6.1 FF5-plus-momentum refit, history, and retune schedules so the new experiment isolates side specialization.

selection.metric: equal-month mean cross-sectional Spearman rank IC
selection.challenger_rule: Choose the highest validation mean IC among all new components and prespecified ensembles; break an exact tie by model_id.
selection.control_comparison: Report the frozen reversed FF5-alpha control separately; do not select a different challenger from the 2024-01 through 2025-08 historical test.

checkpointing.identity_mismatch: fail closed into a new V6.4 output lineage
